facts.fact: The Banque de la Republique du Burundi said BurundiPay is in use by the population for transfers by QR code, USSD and OTP from a phone, in about 10 seconds, for holders of a bank or microfinance account.

systems.owner: Banque de la Republique du Burundi

note: No link between wallets and banks or one national switch stated.
